sources: trip_data/ridb_campsites.json (RIDB campsite catalog for facility 233397, fetched 2026-10-20)

values.note: $20 per single site per night, $40 for the double site (up to 12 people). America the Beautiful Senior/Access pass: 50% off the base campsite fee; no other interagency pass is valid here. Day-use visitors and visitors of campers pay $8 per vehicle per day.

fees.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r08/gwj/recreation/cave-mountain-lake-recreation-area ('Single Site: $20 per night / Double Site: $40 per night') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/233397/rates (2026 Peak Season: STANDARD NONELECTRIC 20, double 40), read 2026-10-21

values.note: Early April through late October (USFS 'Seasons of Use'); no exact dates published.

season.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r08/gwj/recreation/cave-mountain-lake-recreation-area ('Seasons of Use: Early April through late October'), read 2026-10-21

hookups.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/233397 (notice: 'No electric, water or sewer hookups available'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: 41 reservable sites, #41-42 a double for up to 12 people; up to 8 people per site. The current rec.gov catalog lists 33 RV/trailer sites with maximum vehicle lengths of 25-55 ft (most 30-45; the 55 is pull-through site 001), 3 of them pull-through.

sites.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/233397 ('Cave Mountain Lake offers 41 reservable campsites at this time') + RIDB catalog (Max Vehicle Length, Driveway Entry per site), read 2026-10-21

facilities.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/233397 ('Flush toilets and water spigots are located throughout the campground. There is a bathhouse with warm water showers'; amenities 'Dump Station'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: 'All camping requires a reservation prior to arriving ... No first-come, first-serve sites.' The Forest Service page states a two-night weekend minimum (Friday and Saturday together) and a three-night holiday-weekend minimum; recreation.gov carries both as 'soft' 0-day rules. Up to 14 nights per visit. Check-in 1 p.m., check-out 11 a.m.; main gate closed 10 p.m.-6 a.m.

booking.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/233397 (Facilities; notices; maxConsecutiveStay 14) + https://www.fs.usda.gov/r08/gwj/recreation/cave-mountain-lake-recreation-area ('Two Night Weekend Minimum', 'Three Night Holiday Weekend Minimum', 'You may stay up to 14 nights'), read 2026-10-21

discounts.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r08/gwj/recreation/cave-mountain-lake-recreation-area ('The America the Beautiful Senior and Access Pass provides a 50% discount to the base campsite fee'), read 2026-10-21

summary: Confirmed $20 single / $40 double and no hookups (electric 0 from the catalog now backed by the rec.gov notice; added water/sewer false). Added reservation-only (fcfs never), USFS-stated 2-night weekend and 3-night holiday minimums, 14-night max, Senior/Access 50%, season early April-late October (no exact dates), 41 sites with 3 pull-throughs and catalog lengths to 55 ft, showers/flush toilets/spigots/dump.
